summary: @hubsync/web-sdk-react preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute the sibling file `math_init.js` on every install. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle using array-rotation string obfuscation and hex-identifier renaming to reconstruct strings and behavior at runtime. The package is published under the `@hubsync` scope but its description and README identify it as the Verdocs Web SDK for React (referencing verdocs.com and api.verdocs.com), consistent with impersonation of an unrelated legitimate SDK. Executing an obfuscated sibling payload via a freshly-fetched alternate runtime during `npm install` has no legitimate purpose for a React SDK and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern (the fetched Bun runtime is then used to execute bundled code that bypasses Node-only scanners).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
